name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedLeaf.hop_hiding_of_point_separator
title: A point separator for one path makes a one-path mask flip perfectly hidden
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring, c_z row vectors in R^k, t a path and l in R^k with c_t . l = 1 and c_z . l = 0 for every z other than t. Then for any per-path masks M, any new mask m' for path t, any noise e and any test function F, the sum over all A in R^{k x n} of F((M_z + c_z A + e_z)_z) equals the same sum with M replaced by Function.update M t m'.
